record.original_question: (J. Wiegold). Let Γ be a finite simple group and let Nn(Γ) denote the set of normal subgroups of the free group Fn of rank n whose quotient is isomorphic to Γ. Conjecture: Aut(Fn) acts transitively on Nn(Γ) for n ⩾ 3. This is not true for n = 2(B. H. Neumann, H. Neumann, Math. Nachr., 4(1951), 106–125).

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let $F_n$ denote the free group of rank $n$, and let $\mathrm{Aut}(F_n)$ be its automorphism group. For a finite simple group $\Gamma$, let
$$N_n(\Gamma) = \{\, N \trianglelefteq F_n : F_n/N \cong \Gamma \,\}$$
be the set of normal subgroups of $F_n$ whose quotient is isomorphic to $\Gamma$. The group $\mathrm{Aut}(F_n)$ acts on $N_n(\Gamma)$ by $\varphi \cdot N := \varphi(N)$.

Prove or disprove: for every $n \geq 3$ and every finite simple group $\Gamma$, the action of $\mathrm{Aut}(F_n)$ on $N_n(\Gamma)$ is transitive.

(Equivalently, $\mathrm{Aut}(F_n)$ acts transitively on the set of epimorphisms $F_n \twoheadrightarrow \Gamma$ modulo $\mathrm{Aut}(\Gamma)$, i.e., $\Gamma$ has a single $T_n$-system. It is known that the analogous statement fails for $n=2$.)
artifact.category_tag: Wiegold conjecture / T-systems of finite simple groups
artifact.status_search_result: The Wiegold conjecture remains open in general. It is known only in limited cases: results of Garion–Shalev, Avni, and others (using deep input such as Larsen–Pink) establish transitivity for various families of finite simple groups of Lie type, and recent work (e.g., 2025 preprint on small Ree groups) continues to handle further families, indicating the general conjecture is still unresolved.

status_evidence.title: On Wiegold's conjecture for the small Ree groups
status_evidence.snippet: Wiegold conjectured that if n≥3 and G is a finite simple group, then Aut(F_n) acts transitively on Epi(F_n,G); the conjecture is known only in limited cases.
status_evidence.claim: The Wiegold conjecture is still being addressed case by case for families of finite simple groups, indicating it remains open in general.

status_evidence.title: Dynamics of Aut(F_n) actions on group presentations and representations
status_evidence.snippet: Discusses Wiegold's conjecture on transitivity of Aut(F_n) on Epi(F_n,G) for finite simple G and n≥3, surveying partial results.
status_evidence.claim: The conjecture is presented as an open problem with partial progress.
